columns.name: INTERNET_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: System generate unique identifier.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CODE
columns.description: Unique code assigned to each account.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Specifies account name (e.g, Quotation from Supplier, Supplier Recall Letter, etc.,)

columns.name: FAMILY
columns.description: Specifies the product family associated with the internet account.

columns.name: PRODUCT
columns.description: Specifies the product associated with the internet account.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Describes the internet account.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Lookup code that specifies if the account is active or not (e.g., ACTIVE/INACTIVE).

columns.name: USERNAME
columns.description: Specifies username (e.g., Email Address) of the internet account.

columns.name: PROVIDER_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that specifies the provider. (e.g., GMAIL/MSGRAPH).

columns.name: CLIENT_ID
columns.description: Specifies the Client ID associated with the internet account.

columns.name: TENANT_ID
columns.description: Specifies the Tenant ID associated with the internet account.

columns.name: AGENT_ENABLED
columns.description: Specifies if the connection is enabled to be invoked from AI agents (e.g., Y/N).

columns.name: HYBRID_SEARCH_ENABLED
columns.description: Specifies if the emails from this account should be vectorized for hybrid search

columns.name: POLL_INTERVAL
columns.description: Defines how frequently the system polls the email inbox for new messages.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_INFO
columns.description: Used to specify any additional information about the account.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
